content.title: Phibro Animal Health (NASDAQ:PAHC) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q1 CY2026 Earnings
content.summary: Animal health products manufacturer Phibro Animal Health (NASDAQ:PAHC) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales flat year on year at $347.8 million. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $1.46 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.63 per share was 8.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
